_doc: Source-of-truth fixtures for the cross-layer Pedersen hash invariant.
Edited by hand. The recipe `just regen-pedersen-fixtures` regenerates
Fixtures are chosen to exercise byte-encoding boundaries that matter for
the 50-field × 31-byte Pedersen packing of the 1520-byte canonical layout:
- field 49 covers bytes [1519, 1550) but only byte 1519 (=packed[1499])
is in the layout — the remaining 30 bytes are zero-padded carry.
name              slug used in test names and the FIXTURE_HASH:<name> prefix
description       human-readable note about what this fixture exercises
header            10 BE u16s: width, height, sx, sy, robe(x,y), scepter(x,y), goal(x,y)
packedFill        default byte (0..255) for every cell of packed_cells[1500]
packedOverrides   optional sparse [idx, byte] overrides applied after fill

fixtures.name: all-zero
fixtures.description: Sentinel: every byte zero. Pinned across layers since ma-6cr.8.

fixtures.name: all-0xff
fixtures.description: Every byte 0xFF. Exercises the high-byte path through every field, including the trailing-pad byte at index 1519.

fixtures.name: minimal-10x10
fixtures.description: Standard 10x10 header (matches mazeGenerator default), all-zero packed cells. Header-only baseline.

fixtures.name: header-edge-bit
fixtures.description: 10x10 header with packed_cells[0]=1. Pinned across layers since ma-6cr.8 — exercises field 0's header/packed-cells transition (bytes 19→20).

fixtures.name: packed-cells-only
fixtures.description: Zero header, single nonzero byte in the middle of packed_cells. Exercises a non-header byte that does not coincide with field boundaries.

fixtures.name: max-cells-header
fixtures.description: Maximum u16 fields throughout the header. Exercises high-byte serialization of every header u16 (bytes 0..20 all 0xFF) without touching packed_cells.

fixtures.name: field-boundary-byte-30-31
fixtures.description: Bytes at packed_cells[10] (last byte of field 0, byte index 30) and packed_cells[11] (first byte of field 1, byte index 31). Catches drift in the 31-byte chunk transition.

fixtures.name: trailing-pad-byte-1519
fixtures.description: Single nonzero byte at packed_cells[1499] (= byte index 1519 = field 49's only layout byte). Catches drift in the carry-byte zero-padding of the final field — invisible to the two original fixtures.
